hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q '"researches/"' && ! echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '"researches/[a-z0-9_]+/"'; then echo "⚠️ BLOCKED: Research files must be inside researches/<case-slug>/ directory" && exit 1; fi; exit 0'
bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "0[0-8]_.*\.md"; then echo "📋 Artifact created. Remember to update the tracker in README.md"; fi; exit 0'
